units.text: INT. WIZARD'S ABANDONED LIBRARY - TWILIGHT
A circular chamber at the top of a leaning tower.
Shelves spiral to a ceiling lost in cobweb.
Dust hangs in the last red light from a cracked rose window.
On a lectern in the centre lies an enormous book, its pages stirring though there is no wind.
The silence is old and settled.
A heavy door groans.
Boots on stone.
ORRIN THISTLEDOWN, sixties, a thin man in a patched travelling cloak, enters leaning on a gnarled staff.
He is breathing hard from the stairs.
A wiry grey beard, spectacles tied with twine.
He pauses, taking in the room as one takes in a grave.
Well. You kept it tidy, old friend.
units.name: ORRIN

units.text: He crosses to the lectern.
Brushes dust from the open page with the back of his hand.
Reads.
His lips move.
From his satchel he draws a folded letter, brown at the edges.
He smooths it on the lectern beside the book.
"Orrin, if you read this, I am gone, and the tower is yours. The book will not open for anyone but you. Do not be afraid of it. It is only lonely."
units.name: ORRIN
paren: reading the letter, in his younger voice

units.text: Orrin lowers the letter.
He looks up at the rose window, where the last sun is bleeding out.
Lonely. Aye. So are we.
units.name: ORRIN

units.text: He sets his staff against the shelves, rolls up his sleeves, and turns the first page.
A faint golden glow rises from the paper and catches in his spectacles.
There you are.
units.name: ORRIN

units.text: The pages begin to turn on their own, one after another, patient as breathing.
Orrin pulls up a stool and sits.
